article_title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days

tasks.prompt: What is the central development reported in the article?
options: Iran says it has offered the US a conditional plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.
The US has permanently closed the Strait of Hormuz to all shipping.
Iran and the US have already signed a final peace treaty at the UN.
Oil tankers have stopped using every route in the Gulf.
tasks.correct_answer: Iran says it has offered the US a conditional plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האירוע המרכזי הוא הצעת איראן לארה״ב לפתוח מחדש את המצר בתוך שבעה ימים, אם יתקיימו תנאים מסוימים.

tasks.prompt: How was Iran's proposal communicated to the United States?
options: Through a public vote at the UN
Through mediators
Through direct military talks in the strait
Through oil companies
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שר החוץ האיראני אמר שהתוכנית הועברה לארה״ב באמצעות מתווכים.

tasks.prompt: What does “normal maritime passage restored” mean in this context?
options: Naval forces would take control of every commercial vessel.
A new land route would replace the strait.
Ships would again be able to travel through the waterway normally.
Only Iranian tankers would receive permission to sail.
tasks.correct_answer: Ships would again be able to travel through the waterway normally.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: maritime passage הוא מעבר ימי; restored פירושו שהשיט הרגיל במצר יוכל להתחדש.

tasks.prompt: Why is the Strait of Hormuz economically important, according to the article?
options: It contains most of the world's shipbuilding factories.
It is the only route used by passenger ships in Asia.
It controls all food exports from the Middle East.
About 20% of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas used to pass through it before the war.
tasks.correct_answer: About 20% of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas used to pass through it before the war.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שלפני המלחמה עברו במצר כ־20% מן הנפט והגז הטבעי הנוזלי בעולם, ולכן לסגירתו השפעה רחבה.

tasks.prompt: What did the US official say about current contacts with Iran?
options: Positive discussions were taking place through mediators, but the official would not detail Iran's plan.
All communication had ended after the UN meeting.
The US had accepted every condition immediately.
The talks concerned shipping only and excluded nuclear issues.
tasks.correct_answer: Positive discussions were taking place through mediators, but the official would not detail Iran's plan.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: גורם אמריקאי אמר שמתקיימים דיונים חיוביים באמצעות מתווכים, לרבות בנושאי גרעין, אך לא פירט על התוכנית.

tasks.prompt: Why has the strait's closure increased pressure for an agreement?
options: It ended all UN meetings in New York.
It prevented Iran from speaking to mediators.
It disrupted a major energy route and contributed to volatile prices.
It made the June memorandum legally invalid.
tasks.correct_answer: It disrupted a major energy route and contributed to volatile prices.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חסימת נתיב אנרגיה מרכזי גרמה לתנודות מחירים והגבירה את הלחץ להגיע להסדר.

tasks.prompt: State two conditions or actions linked in the report to reopening the strait.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני תנאים או צעדים קונקרטיים שנקשרו להצעה או למזכר ההבנות.
expected_points: The United States would have to accept the terms contained in the June memorandum of understanding.
Reported provisions included easing or lifting the naval blockade.
The plan was linked to sanctions relief for Iranian oil sales.
A ceasefire and a return to negotiations were part of the wider proposed arrangement.

tasks.prompt: Why might both Iran and the United States present themselves as being in no hurry?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד כל צד עשוי להשתמש בזמן ובעמדה הפומבית כמנוף במשא ומתן, תוך הסתמכות על פרטים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Iran says the choice rests with the US and can use the strait as leverage.
A US official said Washington was in a strong position and was not rushing.
The approaching US midterm elections and energy-price pressure may affect the political timetable.
Public claims of patience can strengthen each side's bargaining position.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the proposal, its background and its economic significance.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את לוח הזמנים, התנאים או מזכר יוני, את רקע הלחימה והחסימה, ואת חשיבות המצר לשוק האנרגיה.
expected_points: Iran says the strait could reopen within seven days after the US accepts required conditions.
The proposal refers back to a June memorandum connected to a ceasefire and negotiations.
The current crisis followed attacks, retaliation and the blocking of the strait.
The strait carried a major share of global oil and LNG, so disruption has affected prices.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, assess whether the seven-day proposal is mainly a peace initiative or a bargaining tool.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג עמדה מנומקת או מאוזנת, להשתמש בלפחות שתי ראיות מן הכתבה ולהסביר גם את ממד השלום וגם את ממד הלחץ.
expected_points: It can be seen as a peace initiative because it offers reopening, normal shipping and renewed talks.
It is conditional rather than immediate, tying action to US acceptance of earlier terms.
Control of a vital energy route gives Iran leverage, while sanctions and military pressure give the US leverage.
A strong response should distinguish the proposed timetable from a completed agreement.
